title: Software updates and settings resets
summary: Reviews in this topic center on software quality and update behavior, with complaints about buggy operation, repeated updates, and settings being reset after updates, while a few comments say the software is acceptable or may improve with future updates.

positive.summary: Positive reviews say the software is acceptable or expected to improve through future updates, but concrete praise is limited.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe the software as poor and highlight updates resetting settings and making everyday functions like instrument brightness and auto hold more inconvenient.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention software updates, complexity, bugs, and reboot or setup friction, but the short excerpts often do not make the overall sentiment explicit.

limitations: Most sampled excerpts are undetermined, so the topic direction is constrained by limited explicit sentiment evidence.
The examples are short fragments and often lack enough context to tell whether a software update solved a problem or merely was expected to do so.
The topic is fairly coherent around software and updates, but some fragments refer to general software complexity while others focus specifically on settings resets after updates.
